title: NORMAD: A Framework for Measuring the Cultural Adaptability of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model accuracy in judging the social acceptability of etiquette-related situations across 75 countries, comparing performance gaps between Western/English-speaking cultures and others (e.g., African-Islamic, Global South) using the NORMAD-ETI benchmark.

Analyzing model accuracy across different ground-truth labels (social adherence 'Yes', violation 'No', and neutral) to identify a systematic tendency to approve actions or agree with the premise regardless of the context.
